title: rosa × dumetorum f. cinerosa
intro: Rosa × dumetorum f. cinerosa, commonly known as Rosa rugosa, is a species of rose native to East Asia. This shrub has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and improve mood through its sedative and antidepressant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
